implementation_scope: Standalone one-host bounded protocol consumer; Python standard library; no network, model calls, additional scientific agent, automatic judgment or scored experimental harness
verification_status: Not run during implementation; parent runs after all sibling changes land
command_prerequisites: Sibling-owned evaluation/agent-cli/collective-contract.json with matching transport_consumer and common roles/failure policy
Real already-built ara for the two-process driver, with ara.open/v1 and ara.show/v1 support
Real existing fixture and actual native selector; override --selector when using another fixture
A new --run-root outside the fixture; existing output is rejected rather than overwritten
Parent runs project-wide gates only after siblings complete; this directory contains no build step

utility_api.input: JSON request file or bounded JSON on stdin; operation selects request.schema.json $defs
utility_api.identity: --actor is immutable exact run-scoped identity supplied by a trusted local runner; this is not hostile-process authentication

operations.initialize: Coordinator only; freeze finite run configuration and complete contract digest; durable initial event costs its admitted actor one coordination unit
operations.snapshot: Alias for billed durable refresh; no free coordination view
operations.refresh: Latest committed full view with coordinator sequence/round; actor read is itself one durable coordination event
operations.publish: Actor-owned intention ID, expected_revision=0 and exact observed_sequence/observed_round; planned state with empty result refs
operations.refresh-intention: Owner-only revision CAS; planned/active refresh or completed/abandoned transition; source fields/signatures/verification persist in every history revision
operations.execute: Account explicit research_units plus one coordination unit against the same allocation; active acknowledged intention and registered refresh cadence required; does not execute or judge science
operations.finish-round: Close the actor's allotted action/turn; round advances only after every admitted actor finishes or has registered failure closure
operations.close-failure: Coordinator records a registered reason for the target actor and optionally closes the run; it requires a valid channel and consumes the coordinator's existing allocation
operations.recover: Return original durable acknowledgement for an actor-owned request ID; optional original request_digest must match; --repair-interrupted explicitly completes only a matching durable write-ahead append

exit_codes.0: Accepted operation or original durable receipt retransmission
exit_codes.2: Unavailable/corrupt channel or command setup failure; pause budget-consuming collective work

durability: flock on coordinator.lock serializes the single host coordinator
pending-append.json is atomically written and file+directory fsynced before append
complete events are hash chained, request digests checked, and fsynced before atomic snapshot replacement
snapshot temporary file is fsynced before replace; channel directory is fsynced after replace/removal
normal operations pause on pending/interrupted append; explicit recovery appends missing matching suffix only, never truncates or discards committed bytes
replay verifies every produced acknowledgement and state transition before reconstructing a missing or valid stale-prefix snapshot
malformed/corrupt/truncated committed log without a matching write-ahead record is unavailable, not silently repaired

accounting.research_units: Explicit positive integer on execute; same remaining total as coordination
accounting.reservations: Visible remaining reserved research cannot exceed remaining total after coordination; not extra allocation
accounting.outage: No accepted event or research debit while corrupt/unavailable; collective work pauses
accounting.measurement_limit: Not measured token/CPU accounting or a scored experiment budget implementation; external harness must separately account real model and transport overhead

asserts: unregistered actor and wrong fork identity rejected
original durable receipt returned after later coordination
two subprocesses compete on one observed sequence
one succeeds and one receives actual CAS conflict
explicit loser refresh sees winner before new publication
all actor closures before round advance
fresh at round equal to expiry
expired only at strictly greater round
real process exits after durable commit before receipt delivery
no duplicate accepted event or budget debit
real process exits before/mid/after append and after snapshot
normal work pauses until explicit recovery
valid older snapshot and absent snapshot reconstructed from log during explicit recovery
matching signatures both returned without exclusion or scientific outcome
coordination consumes research's same finite allocation
coordinator closes only registered failure using its own budget
failure closure retains round and recovery receipt
closed run cannot consume further allocation
shared snapshot refresh required in current round
owned intention refresh required at registered cadence
renewed active revision permits visible research accounting
new intention may use released reservation without extra allocation
corrupt partial append cannot be silently repaired
complete previously accepted prefix and snapshot remain intact
unavailable state preserves other owner's publication
boolean/fractional/invalid cadence, duplicate actor and changed failure policy rejected

transitions: B refreshes A's durable sequence before choosing explicit verification
A/B active, research-accounted and completed read actions
disabled shared log pauses actual collective execution
actual ara open/show in both forks remains usable offline
intention refresh observed by other fork
unrefreshed planned intention expires with full retained history
two_process_generated_surface.frontier: Actual ara open native objects annotated with runner-registered source identity, exact knowledge inventory revision and observed intention snapshot sequence; separate active/stale/retained remote intention context records its actual observed sequence/round, complete publisher-declared record and unverified scientific coverage; no covered status invented
two_process_generated_surface.revision_authority: Administrative sorted exact-byte inventory includes PAPER.md, logic/, trace/, staging/, rubric/ and --knowledge-path files; excludes .ara/.git/src/evidence; encoding recorded in evidence
two_process_generated_surface.private_knowledge_mutation: None; fixture copy only and before/after inventory equality
two_process_generated_surface.merge_proof: Parent combines actual PR08 merge smoke separately; driver does not claim a performed merge
